title: Arabian Cement approves €22m vertical mill investment
summary: Arabian Cement approves €22m vertical mill investment
body_markdown:
**Egypt:** Arabian Cement Company’s board has approved a €22m investment in a new 150t/hr vertical cement mill at its plant in Ain Sokhna, Egypt. The project is expected to increase the company’s cement production capacity by 1Mt/yr. The investment will cover equipment supply, mechanical and electrical works, civil engineering, construction, installation, testing and trial operation.


The board authorised managing director Sergio Alcantarilla Rodríguez to secure financing for the project and sign the related contracts.


In the first half of 2026, Arabian Cement’s consolidated profits increased by 54.6% year-on-year to US$40.3m, from US$26m in the corresponding period of 2025.
